title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning

questions.text: Which statement correctly describes supervised learning when applied to financial data?
options: It discovers hidden groupings in data without any predefined labels.
It learns by receiving rewards or penalties after taking actions in an environment.
It uses labeled historical data to map inputs to known outcomes for prediction.
It requires no data and relies solely on expert rules.
questions.explanation: Supervised learning trains on labeled data to predict outcomes.

questions.text: True or false: Reinforcement learning learns through trial, error, and feedback to maximize long-term results.
questions.explanation: RL adjusts its strategy based on rewards and penalties to maximize cumulative reward.
